About • Collections • Blog • Compare • Privacy Policy • Terms of Service • Submit a pedal • © 2026 PedalFilter Clear Compare ( 0 ) Back Home Mojo Hand FX Odessa Back to results Mojo Hand FX Odessa Overdrive Dual-channel overdrive combining Rook and Magpie circuits—stack them for high gain or use independently. The Odessa combines two award-winning Mojo Hand overdrives in one enclosure: the Rook on the left, and the lower-gain Magpie on the right. Both channels are completely independent with their own controls and can be stacked (Magpie into Rook) for excellent high-gain tones. Rook channel features Gain, Bass, Volume, and Treble controls with a 3-way clipping toggle (up: LED, center: none, down: silicon). Magpie channel offers Gain, Tone, and Volume with its own 3-way toggle (up: crunch, center: boost, down: overdrive). Both channels have true bypass switching. Running on ~12mA from 9V center-negative power, the Odessa delivers dual-channel overdrive versatility in a 4.8" × 2.62" × 1.55" enclosure. Discontinued and replaced by the Rock City, which adds series/parallel routing. Hunt for used Odessas for the original dual-channel magic.
